blocks.text: Ko'p fe'llar o'zidan keyin ma'lum bir predlog talab qiladi: **believe in** God, **depend on** the weather, **apologise for** the mistake (→ qizil kitob, 113-dars). Predlogdan keyin harakat kelsa, fe'l **-ing** shaklini oladi (→ 60-dars): I **believe in telling** the truth. O'zbekchada bunday fe'l «-ish» yoki «-gan» qo'shimchasi bilan otga aylanib, kelishik oladi: «rost **gapirish tarafdoriman**», «**kechikkanim uchun** uzr so'radim». Qiyin joyi — predlog har bir fe'lda **o'zgacha** va o'zbekcha kelishikka mos kelmaydi, shuning uchun fe'l va predlogni birga yodlash kerak.

rows: We**'re thinking of moving** to Bukhara.
We **decided against buying** a new car.
I don't **feel like going** out tonight.

items.text: Did the police **succeed in catching** the thieves?
Madina **insisted on showing** us the old city herself.
items.translation: Madina eski shaharni bizga o'zi **ko'rsatishni aytib turib oldi**.

items.text: I don't **feel like cooking** tonight — let's order a pizza.
items.translation: Bugun kechqurun **ovqat qilgim kelmayapti** — pitsa buyurtma qilaylik.

blocks.text: to — predlog bo'lgan fe'llar: look forward to, object to

Ba'zi fe'llardan keyin **to** keladi, lekin bu **to** — predlog, infinitiv belgisi emas. Shuning uchun undan keyin ham -ing: **look forward to seeing** (intiqlik bilan kutmoq), **object to paying** (e'tiroz bildirmoq), **confess to stealing** (tan olmoq), **admit to making** (bo'yniga olmoq). Tekshirish usuli o'sha-o'sha: **to** dan keyin ot qo'yish mumkinmi? «I look forward to **your visit**» — mumkin, demak fe'l -ing bo'ladi. be used to dagi **to** ham xuddi shunday (→ 61-dars).

items.text: We**'re** really **looking forward to meeting** your parents in Fergana.
Several residents **objected to paying** for the new car park.
items.translation: Bir necha aholi yangi avtoturargoh uchun **pul to'lashga e'tiroz bildirdi**.

items.text: The suspect finally **confessed to stealing** the laptops.

blocks.text: Ikkinchi guruh fe'llarda predlogdan oldin **to'ldiruvchi** (kimnidir) turadi: **accuse** somebody **of** -ing (ayblamoq), **suspect** somebody **of** -ing (gumon qilmoq), **congratulate** somebody **on** -ing (tabriklamoq), **prevent / stop** somebody **from** -ing (yo'l qo'ymaslik), **discourage** somebody **from** -ing (ko'nglini qaytarmoq), **thank / forgive / blame** somebody **for** -ing, **warn** somebody **against** -ing (ehtiyot bo'lishga chaqirmoq). O'zbekchada predlog o'rnida kelishik yoki ko'makchi keladi: «uni **o'g'irlikda** ayblashdi», «**kelganingiz uchun** rahmat», «**yutganing bilan** tabriklayman» — shuning uchun o'zbekcha kelishikdan predlog «taxmin qilish» xavfli.

items.text: The manager **accused** Tom **of losing** the contract.
Nothing could **stop** her **from becoming** a pilot.
items.translation: Hech narsa uning uchuvchi **bo'lishiga to'sqinlik qila olmadi**.

items.text: We **congratulated** Kate **on getting** her first job.

blocks.text: Majhul nisbat va -ing ning o'z egasi

Bu fe'llar yangiliklarda ko'pincha majhul nisbatda keladi (→ 42-dars): He **was accused of taking** bribes — U pora olishda **ayblandi**. Britaniya so'zlashuvida **stop / prevent somebody doing** (from siz) ham ishlatiladi: You can't **stop** me **going**. Yana bir nozik joy: -ing harakatini boshqa shaxs bajarsa, u predlogdan keyin turadi: I insisted on **him coming** with us; rasmiyroq uslubda egalik olmoshi: I insisted on **his coming**. Ikkala shakl ham to'g'ri.

items.text: Two ministers **were accused of spending** public money on private trips.
items.translation: Ikki vazir davlat pulini shaxsiy safarlarga **sarflashda ayblandi**.

items.text: Fans without tickets **were prevented from entering** the stadium.
The heavy snow **stopped** us **going** to the mountains at the weekend.
items.translation: Qalin qor tufayli dam olish kunlari tog'ga **bora olmadik**.

blocks.text: **succeed in -ing** va **manage to do** ma'nosi yaqin: She **succeeded in getting** a visa = She **managed to get** a visa; «succeed to do» — xato. **think of -ing** — niyat, reja: I'm **thinking of changing** my job; **think about -ing** — o'ylab ko'rmoq, mulohaza qilmoq. **would never dream of -ing** — «xayoliga ham keltirmaydi»: She **would never dream of cheating**.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: (1) predlog o'rniga infinitiv: «He insisted to pay» → insisted **on paying**; «She succeeded to find» → succeeded **in finding**. (2) «I'm thinking to buy a car» → I'm thinking **of buying** a car. (3) to-predlogdan keyin oddiy fe'l: «I look forward to see you» → **to seeing** you. (4) o'zbekcha kelishikdan tarjima: «congratulate with» → **congratulate on**; «accuse in» → **accuse of**; «prevent to go» → **prevent from going**. (5) «Thank you for help me» → Thank you **for helping** me.

Fe'l va predlogni bitta so'zdek yodlang: «succeed-in», «insist-on», «accuse-of», «prevent-from», «congratulate-on». Qoida esa bitta: predlogdan keyin hech qachon «to + fe'l» bo'lmaydi — predlog + **-ing**.

rows: succeed in, insist on, think of, dream of, approve of, feel like, decide against, apologise for
She **dreams of travelling** round the world.
look forward to, object to, confess to
I **look forward to hearing** from you.
accuse of, suspect of, congratulate on, thank for, blame for, prevent from, warn against
be accused of, be suspected of, be prevented from

examples.title: **succeed in**, **insist on**, **believe in** + -ing
examples.description: Fe'l + predlog + -ing: muvaffaqiyat, qat'iy talab va ishonch (succeed in, insist on, believe in, specialise in).

sentences.text: After three attempts, Aziz finally **succeeded in passing** his driving test.
sentences.translation: Uch urinishdan keyin Aziz nihoyat haydovchilik imtihonidan **o'tishga muvaffaq bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: The firefighters **succeeded in rescuing** everyone from the burning building.
sentences.translation: O't o'chiruvchilar yonayotgan binodagi hammani **qutqarib qolishga muvaffaq bo'lishdi**.

sentences.text: My grandfather always **insists on walking** to the mosque, even in the snow.
sentences.translation: Bobom hatto qor yog'ganda ham masjidga **piyoda boraman, deb turib oladi**.

sentences.text: Sarah **insisted on checking** every number in the report herself.
sentences.translation: Sara hisobotdagi har bir raqamni o'zi **tekshirishni talab qildi**.

sentences.text: Do you **believe in giving** children pocket money?
sentences.translation: Bolalarga cho'ntak puli **berish to'g'ri**, deb hisoblaysizmi?

sentences.text: Our company **believes in treating** every customer like a friend.
sentences.translation: Kompaniyamiz har bir mijozga do'stdek **munosabatda bo'lish tarafdori**.

sentences.text: Nobody **succeeded in persuading** Jasur to stay in the team.
sentences.translation: Hech kim Jasurni jamoada qolishga **ko'ndira olmadi**.

sentences.text: Why do you always **insist on doing** everything your own way?
sentences.translation: Nega doim hamma narsani o'zingizcha **qilishda turib olasiz**?

sentences.text: The scientists at this institute **specialise in studying** earthquakes.
sentences.translation: Bu institut olimlari zilzilalarni **o'rganishga ixtisoslashgan**.

sentences.text: Did the new coach **succeed in improving** the team's results this season?
sentences.translation: Yangi murabbiy bu mavsum jamoa natijalarini **yaxshilashga erisha oldimi**?

examples.title: **think of**, **dream of**, **feel like** + -ing
examples.description: Reja, orzu va xohish: think of / about -ing (niyat), dream of -ing (orzu), feel like -ing («...gisi kelmoq»), decide against -ing.

sentences.text: We**'re thinking of moving** to Samarkand when the children finish school.
sentences.translation: Bolalar maktabni tugatgach, Samarqandga **ko'chib o'tishni o'ylayapmiz**.

sentences.text: Bekzod has always **dreamed of playing** for a big European club.
sentences.translation: Bekzod doim katta Yevropa klubida **o'ynashni orzu qilgan**.

sentences.text: I don't **feel like going** to the gym today — I'm exhausted.
sentences.translation: Bugun sport zaliga **borgim kelmayapti** — juda charchaganman.

sentences.text: **Are** you **thinking about applying** for that job in Oxford?
sentences.translation: O'sha Oksforddagi ishga **ariza topshirishni o'ylayapsizmi**?

sentences.text: Emma **dreams of opening** a small bookshop by the sea.
sentences.translation: Emma dengiz bo'yida kichik kitob do'koni **ochishni orzu qiladi**.

sentences.text: Nobody **felt like dancing** after the bad news about the factory.
sentences.translation: Zavod haqidagi yomon xabardan keyin hech kimning **raqsga tushgisi kelmadi**.

sentences.text: Have you ever **thought of starting** your own business?
sentences.translation: Hech qachon o'z biznesingizni **boshlashni o'ylab ko'rganmisiz**?

sentences.text: When it's this hot, nobody **feels like eating** anything heavy.
sentences.translation: Havo bunchalik issiq bo'lganda, hech kimning og'ir taom **yegisi kelmaydi**.

sentences.text: My sister **would never dream of lying** to our parents.
sentences.translation: Opam ota-onamizga **yolg'on gapirishni** xayoliga ham **keltirmaydi**.

sentences.text: After the interview, Nilufar **decided against accepting** the offer because the salary was low.
sentences.translation: Suhbatdan keyin Nilufar maosh past bo'lgani uchun taklifni **qabul qilmaslikka qaror qildi**.

examples.title: Opinions: **approve of**, **object to**, **look forward to**
examples.description: Fikr va kutish: approve of -ing, object to -ing, look forward to -ing, confess to -ing — oxirgi uchtasida to predlog.

sentences.text: My parents don't **approve of** me **travelling** alone at night.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam tunda yolg'iz **yo'lga chiqishimni ma'qullashmaydi**.

sentences.text: Most doctors **disapprove of giving** antibiotics for a simple cold.
sentences.translation: Ko'pchilik shifokorlar oddiy shamollashda antibiotik **berishni ma'qullamaydi**.

sentences.text: I**'m** really **looking forward to visiting** Edinburgh in August.
sentences.translation: Avgustda Edinburgga **borishni** intiqlik bilan **kutyapman**.

sentences.text: Several passengers **objected to paying** extra for their hand luggage.
sentences.translation: Bir necha yo'lovchi qo'l yuki uchun qo'shimcha **pul to'lashga e'tiroz bildirdi**.

sentences.text: We **look forward to receiving** your application before Friday.
sentences.translation: Arizangizni juma kunigacha **kutib qolamiz**.

sentences.text: Does your boss **object to** you **working** from home on Fridays?
sentences.translation: Boshlig'ingiz juma kunlari uydan **ishlashingizga qarshi emasmi**?

sentences.text: The kids **are looking forward to going** to the seaside next week.
sentences.translation: Bolalar kelasi hafta dengiz bo'yiga **borishni orziqib kutishyapti**.

sentences.text: Teachers in this school don't **approve of** students **using** phones in class.
sentences.translation: Bu maktab o'qituvchilari o'quvchilarning darsda telefon **ishlatishini ma'qullamaydi**.

sentences.text: Why do you **object to sharing** an office with James?
sentences.translation: Nega Jeyms bilan bitta xonada **ishlashga qarshisiz**?

sentences.text: Kate **confessed to eating** the last piece of cake, but she didn't say sorry.
sentences.translation: Keyt tortning oxirgi bo'lagini **yeganini tan oldi**, lekin kechirim so'ramadi.

examples.title: **apologise for**, **complain about**, **depend on**
examples.description: Uzr, shikoyat, diqqat va bog'liqlik: apologise for, complain about, concentrate on, depend on, talk about + -ing.

sentences.text: The airline **apologised for cancelling** our flight without warning.
sentences.translation: Aviakompaniya reysimizni ogohlantirmasdan **bekor qilgani uchun uzr so'radi**.

sentences.text: Tom **apologised to** his wife **for forgetting** their anniversary.
sentences.translation: Tom xotinidan to'y yilligini **unutgani uchun kechirim so'radi**.

sentences.text: Customers often **complain about waiting** too long at the bank.
sentences.translation: Mijozlar ko'pincha bankda uzoq **kutishdan shikoyat qiladi**.

sentences.text: During exams, try to **concentrate on answering** the questions you know.
sentences.translation: Imtihon paytida avval biladigan savollaringizga **javob berishga e'tibor qarating**.

sentences.text: Our plans **depend on** Bekzod **getting** the visa in time.
sentences.translation: Rejalarimiz Bekzodning vizani o'z vaqtida **olishiga bog'liq**.

sentences.text: Stop **complaining about having** no money and look for a part-time job.
sentences.translation: Pulim yo'q, deb **shikoyat qilishni** bas qiling va yarim kunlik ish qidiring.

sentences.text: She couldn't **concentrate on reading** because of the noise outside.
sentences.translation: Tashqaridagi shovqin tufayli u **o'qishga diqqatini jamlay olmadi**.

sentences.text: Have you **apologised for shouting** at your brother?
sentences.translation: Ukangga **baqirganing uchun kechirim so'radingmi**?

sentences.text: The success of the project **depends on** everyone **working** together.
sentences.translation: Loyihaning muvaffaqiyati hammaning birgalikda **ishlashiga bog'liq**.

sentences.text: Instead of **talking about buying** a flat, Madina and Aziz started saving money.
sentences.translation: Madina va Aziz kvartira **olish haqida gapirish** o'rniga pul yig'ishni boshlashdi.

examples.title: **accuse** / **suspect** somebody **of**, **blame for**
examples.description: Fe'l + kimnidir + predlog + -ing: ayblash va gumon — accuse of, suspect of, blame for.

sentences.text: The coach **accused** the referee **of helping** the other team.
sentences.translation: Murabbiy hakamni raqib jamoaga **yordam berishda aybladi**.

sentences.text: Police **suspect** two men **of breaking** into the jewellery shop.
sentences.translation: Politsiya ikki erkakni zargarlik do'koniga **bostirib kirishda gumon qilmoqda**.

sentences.text: Don't **blame** me **for missing** the train — you were the one who was late!
sentences.translation: Poyezddan **qolganimiz uchun** meni **ayblama** — kechikkan sen eding-ku!

sentences.text: Emma **accused** her flatmate **of reading** her diary.
sentences.translation: Emma xonadoshini kundaligini **o'qishda aybladi**.

sentences.text: Nobody **suspected** the quiet accountant **of stealing** money from the company.
sentences.translation: Hech kim kamgap hisobchini kompaniyadan pul **o'g'irlashda gumon qilmadi**.

sentences.text: **Are** you **accusing** me **of lying**? I told you the truth!
sentences.translation: Meni **yolg'on gapirishda ayblayapsizmi**? Men sizga haqiqatni aytdim!

sentences.text: Many people **blame** social media **for making** teenagers less confident.
sentences.translation: Ko'pchilik o'smirlarni o'ziga ishonchsiz **qilib qo'yishda** ijtimoiy tarmoqlarni **ayblaydi**.

sentences.text: Jasur **blamed** himself **for not checking** the tyres before the trip.
sentences.translation: Jasur safardan oldin shinalarni **tekshirmagani uchun** o'zini **aybladi**.

sentences.text: The journalist **was accused of inventing** parts of the interview.
sentences.translation: Jurnalist intervyuning bir qismini **to'qib chiqarishda ayblandi**.

sentences.text: Why does your sister always **accuse** you **of taking** her clothes?
sentences.translation: Nega opang doim seni kiyimlarini **olishda ayblaydi**?

examples.title: **prevent** / **stop** / **discourage** somebody **from**
examples.description: Yo'l qo'ymaslik, to'sqinlik qilish: prevent / stop / discourage / protect somebody from -ing. Britaniyada stop somebody doing ham deyiladi.

sentences.text: The heavy snow **prevented** us **from driving** to Chimgan.
sentences.translation: Qalin qor tufayli Chimyonga mashinada **bora olmadik**.

sentences.text: Nothing will **stop** Dilnoza **from becoming** a doctor — she's very determined.
sentences.translation: Hech narsa Dilnozaning shifokor **bo'lishiga to'sqinlik qila olmaydi** — u juda qat'iyatli.

sentences.text: A strong password **protects** your account **from being** hacked.
sentences.translation: Kuchli parol akkauntingizni **buzib kirilishdan himoya qiladi**.

sentences.text: Her parents tried to **discourage** her **from studying** abroad.
sentences.translation: Ota-onasi uning chet elda **o'qish niyatidan qaytarishga** urinishdi.

sentences.text: Can you **stop** the dog **barking**? The neighbours are complaining.
sentences.translation: Itning **hurishini to'xtata olasanmi**? Qo'shnilar shikoyat qilyapti.

sentences.text: What **prevented** you **from finishing** the report on time?
sentences.translation: Hisobotni o'z vaqtida **tugatishingizga** nima **xalaqit berdi**?

sentences.text: High prices **discourage** many young people **from buying** their own homes.
sentences.translation: Yuqori narxlar ko'p yoshlarning o'z uyini **sotib olishga ishtiyoqini so'ndiradi**.

sentences.text: The new law **will prevent** companies **from collecting** personal data without permission.
sentences.translation: Yangi qonun kompaniyalarning ruxsatsiz shaxsiy ma'lumot **yig'ishiga yo'l qo'ymaydi**.

sentences.text: I put a note on the door to **stop** people **from ringing** the bell.
sentences.translation: Hech kim qo'ng'iroqni **chalmasin deb**, eshikka yozuv yopishtirdim.

sentences.text: Wearing a helmet won't **stop** you **from falling**, but it can save your life.
sentences.translation: Dubulg'a sizni **yiqilishdan saqlamaydi**, lekin hayotingizni saqlab qolishi mumkin.

examples.title: **thank**, **congratulate**, **forgive**, **warn** somebody
examples.description: Minnatdorlik, tabrik, kechirim va ogohlantirish: thank / forgive somebody for -ing, congratulate somebody on -ing, warn somebody against -ing.

sentences.text: **Thank** you **for helping** me move into my new flat last weekend.
sentences.translation: O'tgan dam olish kunlari yangi kvartiramga **ko'chishimga yordam berganingiz uchun rahmat**.

sentences.text: We **congratulated** Aziz **on winning** the chess tournament.
sentences.translation: Biz Azizni shaxmat turnirida **g'olib bo'lgani bilan tabrikladik**.

sentences.text: Will Kate ever **forgive** me **for missing** her wedding?
sentences.translation: Keyt to'yiga **bormaganim uchun** meni qachondir **kechirarmikin**?

sentences.text: The mayor **thanked** the volunteers **for cleaning** up the park after the festival.
sentences.translation: Shahar hokimi festivaldan keyin bog'ni **tozalagani uchun** ko'ngillilarga **minnatdorchilik bildirdi**.

sentences.text: Let me **congratulate** you **on getting** into Oxford — that's amazing news!
sentences.translation: Oksfordga **o'qishga kirganingiz bilan tabriklayman** — bu ajoyib yangilik!

sentences.text: My doctor **warned** me **against lifting** anything heavy for a month.
sentences.translation: Shifokorim bir oy davomida og'ir narsa **ko'tarmaslikni tayinladi**.

sentences.text: I'll never **forgive** myself **for not visiting** Grandma more often.
sentences.translation: Buvimnikiga tez-tez **bormaganim uchun** o'zimni hech qachon **kechirmayman**.

sentences.text: Did you **thank** Mr Brown **for writing** that reference for you?
sentences.translation: Janob Braunga siz uchun tavsiyanoma **yozgani uchun rahmat aytdingizmi**?

sentences.text: Sarah's colleagues **congratulated** her **on being** promoted to head of department.
sentences.translation: Hamkasblari Sarani bo'lim boshlig'i **lavozimiga ko'tarilgani bilan tabriklashdi**.

sentences.text: Experts **warn** tourists **against swimming** in the river because of strong currents.
sentences.translation: Mutaxassislar kuchli oqim tufayli sayyohlarni daryoda **cho'milmaslikka chaqiradi**.

examples.title: Mixed: news headlines and everyday life
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: fe'l + predlog + -ing va fe'l + kimnidir + predlog + -ing, majhul nisbatda ham.

sentences.text: A former minister **has been accused of accepting** bribes from foreign companies.
sentences.translation: Sobiq vazir xorijiy kompaniyalardan **pora olishda ayblandi**.

sentences.text: Thanks to the new vaccine, doctors **succeeded in stopping** the spread of the disease.
sentences.translation: Yangi vaksina tufayli shifokorlar kasallik tarqalishini **to'xtatishga muvaffaq bo'lishdi**.

sentences.text: Protesters **were prevented from reaching** the parliament building by the police.
sentences.translation: Politsiya namoyishchilarning parlament binosiga **yetib borishiga yo'l qo'ymadi**.

sentences.text: The phone company **apologised for sending** customers the wrong bills.
sentences.translation: Telefon kompaniyasi mijozlarga noto'g'ri hisob **yuborgani uchun uzr so'radi**.

sentences.text: Is anyone **thinking of going** to the concert at the Registan on Saturday?
sentences.translation: Kimdir shanba kuni Registondagi konsertga **borishni o'ylayaptimi**?

sentences.text: Oliver **insisted on** us **staying** for dinner, so we didn't get home until midnight.
sentences.translation: Oliver kechki ovqatga **qolishimizni aytib turib oldi**, shuning uchun uyga yarim tundagina qaytdik.

sentences.text: Two students **were suspected of cheating** in the final exam, but nothing was proved.
sentences.translation: Ikki talaba yakuniy imtihonda **ko'chirishda gumon qilindi**, lekin hech narsa isbotlanmadi.

sentences.text: Rather than **apologising for being** rude, Tom **blamed** everyone else **for upsetting** him.
sentences.translation: Qo'pollik **qilgani uchun uzr so'rash** o'rniga Tom boshqalarni uni **xafa qilganlikda aybladi**.

sentences.text: Bad weather **stopped** the rescue team **from searching** the mountains overnight.
sentences.translation: Yomon ob-havo tufayli qutqaruv guruhi tun bo'yi tog'larni **qidira olmadi**.

sentences.text: We**'re looking forward to celebrating** Navruz with our English friends this year.
sentences.translation: Bu yil Navro'zni ingliz do'stlarimiz bilan **nishonlashni intiqlik bilan kutyapmiz**.
